As corporate investments in AI continue to grow, [Corporate America is starting to ration AI as costs skyrocket](https://www.wsj.com/tech/ai/corporate-america-is-starting-to-ration-ai-as-cost-skyrockets-1eb99d7a), raising concerns about sustainability and access to advanced technologies.

The programming community has a lot to discuss with the release of [Zig: Build System Reworked](https://ziglang.org/devlog/2026/#2026-05-26), which offers improvements that developers have been eagerly awaiting. ## Other Notable Mentions
In cultural discussions, [Leo's first encyclical attacks technological messianism](https://www.economist.com/europe/2026/05/28/leos-first-encyclical-attacks-technological-messianism), reflecting on the societal impacts of technology. Lastly, a fascinating exploration titled [What Happened to the Locusts?](https://explosion-scratch.github.io/locusts/) has captured attention, shedding light on ecological changes affecting these insects.

This week’s top stories reflect the dynamic interplay between technology, science, and societal concerns, providing a rich landscape for discussion and exploration.
